notes: New: Advanced panel moved to dedicated third tab on hamburger menu — main window decluttered, all settings accessible via History/Themes/Advanced tabs
Fix: auto-update check no longer fires when the toggle is off — removed unconditional 3-second timer that bypassed the setting
Security: updateSplash escape chain hardened — backslash, single quote, carriage return, and Unicode line terminators now properly escaped; progress value clamped 0-100
Polish: splash progress bar shimmer animation — subtle sweep effect indicates activity during backend startup

New: 20 themes added across 4 new categories — Food & Drink (Espresso, Matcha, Honey, Merlot, Saffron), Weather (Golden Hour, Overcast, Northern Lights, Thunderstorm, Sirocco), Space (Nebula, Pulsar, Solar Flare, Event Horizon, Andromeda), Architecture (Brutalist, Art Deco, Blueprint, Marble, Gothic)
Upgrade: Electron 42.2.0 (Chromium 148) — latest stable runtime with updated security patches and performance improvements
New: splash screen with progress bar during startup — shows backend initialization and ffmpeg download status instead of a blank gap after the launcher closes
Fix: cookies age display now shows "0d old" on fresh installs and after settings reset — falls back to file modification time when the saved timestamp is missing from settings
Polish: plugin version display now uses a stacked layout (name above, version below) — prevents long version strings from overlapping adjacent UI elements
Fix: CMD window no longer flashes briefly when launching from the installer finish page — NSIS now invokes the VBS launcher directly instead of through a batch file
Security: format_id validation added at run_download use site (was endpoint-only) — defense in depth against future callers that might bypass the /api/download endpoint validation
Diagnostic: invalid bitrate at the postprocessor use site now raises explicitly instead of silently substituting 192 — surfaces upstream validation gaps loudly rather than quietly

Security: outbound HTTP requests now restricted to a whitelist of trusted hosts (GitHub, PyPI, ffmpeg sources, egerena.com) — prevents any future code path from accidentally reaching unintended destinations
Security: redirect targets verified against the same whitelist — blocks redirects that lead off-list, even from legitimate hosts
Security: archive extractions (ffmpeg, Deno, app installer) now explicitly guard against path traversal — defense in depth alongside Python's existing zipfile sanitization
Security: job queue bounded to prevent unbounded memory growth in long sessions — returns 429 if a session ever accumulates 1000+ jobs
Polish: HTTP timeouts centralized into two named constants (15s for metadata, 120s for downloads) — consistent behavior across every outbound request
